# dns_sshfp_record_set (Data Source)

Use this data source to get SSHFP records of a host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dns_sshfp_record_set" "example" {
  host = "example.com."
}

output "fingerprint" {
  value = data.dns_sshfp_record_set.example.fingerprint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Host to look up.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (Number) The SSHFP algorithm number.
- `fingerprint` (String) The SSHFP fingerprint.
- `fingerprint_type` (Number) The SSHFP fingerprint type.
- `id` (String) Always set to the host.
- `ttl` (Number) The TTL of the record.
